title: Hardware variant baseline contracts and graceful fallback strategy for model onboarding
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Define and publish per-hardware baseline performance contracts ("A100 / H100 / L40S / MI300") that are used during model onboarding, automatic pinning, and runtime routing. This ticket scopes the contract (metrics, measurement windows, and acceptable deltas), the canary validation flow, and the graceful fallback mapping used when a hardware variant fails to meet a contract. Deliverables: (1) canonical baseline spec for each GPU family, (2) canary test harness runbook, (3) fallback compatibility matrix, and (4) publication / rollback playbook for the console and model catalog.
technical_notes: Measurement harness: 95th and 99th percentile token latency (cold/warm), steady-state throughput at 99% GPU utilization target, peak memory headroom, and token quality deltas measured by eval prompt set. Quantization acceptance thresholds: <= 1.5% drop in pass@k-like metric for chat completions for 4-bit variants; higher strictness for base models used in retrieval-augmented flows. KV cache warmup policy: 3-minute warm window for long-lived sessions; warm/cold signatures must be published separately. Margin rules: require at least 10% memory headroom for H100/L40S profiles, 12% for MI300 on mixed-precision configs. Canonical test artifacts stored in S3: s3://redwood-onboarding/artifacts/{model}/{hw}/v{profile}.
acceptance_criteria: Baseline spec exists for A100, H100, L40S, MI300 with explicit numeric thresholds (p95/p99 latency, throughput, mem_headroom, quality_delta)
Canary harness implemented and integrated with CI; 3 successful canary runs demonstrating stability across two model sizes (small/medium)
Fallback matrix defined and validated: for each hw variant list the compatible fallback model variant and quantization level
Console integration: published profiles are visible in model catalog UI and flagged with 'baseline-contract-v1'
Rollout playbook includes automatic rollback criteria (p99 regression > 12% or quality_delta > allowed threshold) and post-rollback remediation steps
rollout_plan: Draft baseline spec and circulate to Runtime, Model-Infra, and QA (2 days)
Implement canary harness (kitchen) and run against two representative models (4 days)
Publish profiles to staging model catalog and surface in console for internal validation (1 day)
Run 1-week staggered canary across regions: NA -> EU -> APAC; monitor p95/p99, throughput, and quality dashboards (7 days)
Approve and publish to production catalog; tag profiles with release runtime-1.19 and create release note entry
fallback_matrix: A100 (fp16) -> fallback: A100 (fp16, soft-pin same model) or H100 (fp16) if A100 capacity unavailable
H100 (fp16) -> fallback: A100 (fp16) with enforced lower batch size; disallow falling back to MI300 for models requiring NV_itex kernels
L40S (tensor-core optimized) -> fallback: L40S quantized variant or H100 with quantization-aware fallback, preserve KV cache semantics
MI300 (bf16/mixed) -> fallback: MI300 reduced-seq variant or H100 with LOADED-compat shim; require compatibility gating for mixed-precision kernels
